A little clarity

Good questions.
Clear next steps.

The essentials before your first conversation with Farra.

Sessions & appointments

How do I book?+
Use the enquiry form to prepare a WhatsApp message, or contact +60 12-275 4883 directly. Farra confirms the appointment, price and arrangements in the conversation.
What does the RM50 hydrogen trial include?+
The supplied promotion lists a hydrogen tube, inhalation, hydrogen water, hydrogen goggles, two blood glucose readings and two blood pressure readings. Confirm current inclusions, duration and any travel fees.
Do you travel to customers?+
The supplied trial poster advertises mobile visits. Ask Farra to confirm your area and any additional cost.
Are readings a diagnosis or proof that treatment worked?+
No. Screening readings require appropriate interpretation and can change for many reasons. Consult a qualified healthcare professional about your results.
Can I stop my medication if I try hydrogen?+
Do not stop or change prescribed care based on this service. Speak with your treating clinician. No medical result is guaranteed here.

Coaching & products

Where is the mobile spa coaching held?+
The supplied promotion lists JF Academy, Bandar Tasik Permaisuri, Cheras, with flexible appointments. Confirm the exact location and directions with Farra.
What does RM69 cover?+
The promotion describes personal coaching with basic theory, practical facial learning, business strategy and marketing discussion. Confirm the current fee, duration, materials, participation certificate and support-group terms.
Can I buy a device from the website?+
There is no online checkout. Ask Farra about the exact model, price, availability, warranty, accessories and service support.
Are all the photographs real locations or customers?+
No. Product and venue settings are styled AI-generated illustrations. The event archive also contains original supplied promotional posters. Farra’s portrait uses her actual profile photo as a reference. No generated image is presented as a customer testimonial.

Business opportunities

Do I need experience?+
The supplied business promotion welcomes beginners. Ask about the actual training, responsibilities and requirements for the pathway you are considering.
How much could I earn?+
No amount is promised. Request written programme details, understand the costs, and assess likely activity and expenses before deciding.
